get.description:
Lists posts from a Truth Social profile by handle or account id. Results are paged: while `data.page.hasMore` is true, send `data.page.nextCursor` as `cursor` to get the next page.

> **请求示例待验证。** 此接口的请求示例尚未在生产环境验证。静态示例用于说明请求格式，请替换为自己的参数。正式调用前，可用免费的报价模式（`X-AISA-Cost-Mode: quote`）查看预估费用。

schema.description: Truth Social handle or account id.
Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response. Omit for the first page.
Include reply posts as well as top-level posts when enabled.

aisa_pagination.description: AIsa pagination. Pass next_cursor as cursor to fetch the next page; has_more is false on the last page.

X-AISA-Next-Cursor.description: Mirrors aisa_pagination.next_cursor; absent on the last page.
